title: I'm Quitting Heroing
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Leo Demonheart, the hero who defeated Demon Queen Echidna, is exiled by humans who fear he will become the next demon king. He asks to join Echidna's army instead and, in disguise, helps her Elite Four rebuild it, learning that she invaded to find the Philosopher's Stone and make her polluted homeland fertile. Flashbacks reveal Leo as a 3,000-year-old product of human experiments, programmed to be a hero and longing to be free.
life_message: Worth is found in being valued by people who accept you, not in a role others programmed for you.
